meta.title: Baden to Backwaters | Your Kerala. Your way.
meta.description: Custom Kerala journeys from Germany, shaped around your interests. Mountains, backwaters, food, culture and a local guide throughout. From €2,300 per person.

hero.eyebrow: FROM GERMANY TO THE GOD'S OWN COUNTRY.
hero.title: From Baden to Backwaters.
hero.subtitle: Your trip. Your interests. Your pace. Your Kerala.
hero.body: From misty tea gardens to quiet waterways. From home cooking and living traditions to beaches, wildlife and mountain roads. Choose what moves you. We will build the journey around it.
hero.inclusions: Flights · Visa support · Stays · Transport · Experiences · Local guide
hero.inclusionsNote: Inclusions are tailored to your confirmed itinerary.

intro.title: Choose the experience. We create the journey.
intro.body: Not everyone wants the same holiday. Stay longer in the mountains, learn to cook with a local host, discover a village road or let a houseboat set the pace. You do not have to choose a standard package.
promise: You tell us what interests you.

landscapes.title: From the mountains to the water. And beyond.
landscapes.intro: These are possibilities, not a fixed route. Your interests decide what comes next.

chapters.title: Breathe a little deeper.
chapters.body: Tea gardens, cool highland air and mornings with nowhere to rush.

chapters.title: Let the world slow down.
chapters.body: Coconut palms, village waterways and time to simply watch the water.

chapters.title: Leave room for the sea.
chapters.body: Warm sand, sea breezes and evenings that belong to the sunset.

experiences.title: What kind of Kerala do you want?
experiences.body: Start with a few favourites. There is space for discovery along the way.

cards.title: Nature, at your pace
cards.body: Walk through tea plantations, explore forests and waterfalls, watch birds and find a mountain viewpoint for sunrise.

cards.title: A taste of everyday Kerala
cards.body: Visit a local home or selected cooking experience. Discover spices, coconut and curry leaves, then share the meal you helped prepare.

cards.title: Traditions that tell a story
cards.body: Discover Kathakali, Theyyam, percussion and Kalaripayattu, with local context that helps the experience come alive. Availability depends on place and dates.

cards.title: Travel beyond the postcard
cards.body: Explore markets, village roads, local crafts and everyday food. A traditional toddy shop visit can be discussed as part of your itinerary.

cards.title: Life along the water
cards.body: Choose an overnight houseboat stay, a quiet canoe excursion or a closer look at life beside the smaller waterways.

cards.title: Wild moments, respectfully
cards.body: Observe wildlife from a respectful distance and learn about the landscape it calls home. Elephant and other wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed.

cards.title: Make space for stillness
cards.body: Add yoga, meditation, a nature retreat or time by the sea. Ayurveda experiences can be discussed with suitable local providers.

cards.title: Take the scenic way
cards.body: Trekking, cycling, canoeing, photography and guided motorcycle journeys can bring a more active rhythm to your trip.

houseboat.title: A night on the backwaters. A different sense of time.
houseboat.body: No rushing. Just water, coconut palms and the gentle movement of village life. Stay overnight on a traditional-style houseboat, then explore smaller waterways by canoe if you wish.
items: Dinner and an overnight stay on board
Kerala meals as agreed in your package
Optional village, canal and private canoe excursions
houseboat.note: Boat type, route and inclusions are confirmed in your itinerary.

motorcycle.title: Ride your own story.
motorcycle.body: The road climbs. The air cools. Tea gardens appear between the mist. For experienced riders, we can shape a journey around scenic roads and mountain landscapes.
motorcycle.guide: A local guide accompanies your motorcycle journey.
motorcycle.support: Your guide helps with navigation, stops, local knowledge and practical support while you enjoy the ride.
motorcycle.note: Routes depend on conditions, rider experience and itinerary. Licence, insurance, equipment and rental requirements are confirmed during planning.

destinations.title: Find your own corners of Kerala.

items.name: Varkala
items.body: Cliffs, Arabian Sea sunsets, beach life and a slower coastal rhythm.

items.name: Kovalam
items.body: Crescent-shaped beaches, lighthouse views and time beside the sea.

items.name: Fort Kochi
items.body: Heritage streets, Chinese fishing nets, art, food and history.

items.name: Alappuzha
items.body: Backwaters, canoes, houseboats and village life.

items.name: Munnar
items.body: Tea plantations, misty mountain landscapes and cool highland air.

items.name: Thekkady
items.body: Spice plantations, forests and wildlife experiences.

items.name: Wayanad
items.body: Green mountains, waterfalls, forests and rural landscapes.

items.name: North Kerala
items.body: Theyyam, Malabar cuisine and culture beyond the classic circuit.

duration.title: Your journey has its own rhythm.
duration.body: Start with a one-week escape or take more time for Kerala and a longer South India journey. More mountains, more beaches, more local life: the route can grow with your interests.
duration.note: Duration and route are planned together. Travel time between places is part of the experience.

journeys.eyebrow: A STARTING POINT, NOT A FIXED PACKAGE

items.name: The Kerala Essential
items.body: A considered introduction to Kerala's iconic landscapes and experiences.
items.note: A route idea to adapt to your dates and pace.

items.name: The Kerala Experience
items.body: More time for local life, varied landscapes and unhurried discoveries.
items.highlights: Mountains · Wildlife · Culture · Backwaters · Beaches · Food
items.note: Choose fewer stops for a slower journey.

items.name: Your Private Kerala
items.body: Tell us what you love, how long you have and how you like to travel. We will create the journey from scratch.
items.highlights: Your interests · Your pace · Your route
items.note: There is no standard itinerary unless you want one.

guide.eyebrow: THE HUMAN SIDE OF THE JOURNEY
guide.title: We do not just book your trip. We travel with you.
guide.body: From arrival onwards, our local team helps you experience Kerala comfortably and confidently. You have room to explore, with someone to turn to along the way.
guide.closing: Independent enough to feel free. Supported enough to feel at ease.

whyUs.title: Two sides of your journey, brought together.
whyUs.closing: A Kerala experience that feels personal, comfortable and connected.

inclusions.title: Bring the details together.
inclusions.body: Your package can bring the major elements of your holiday into one coordinated plan. Exact inclusions depend on your chosen itinerary.
items: Meals according to the selected package
inclusions.note: Every inclusion and any optional extra is set out in your final proposal.

price.title: Start your Kerala journey.
price.body: Create your own group and we will design the experience around you, from one week to as long as you like.
price.footnote: *Starting price is subject to travel dates, departure airport, flight availability, accommodation category, itinerary, group size and selected experiences. Final pricing is confirmed before booking.

responsible.title: Travel with care for the places you meet.
responsible.body: Where possible, our journeys include local guides, locally connected stays, small-group experiences, local food and businesses, respectful cultural visits and slower travel through fewer places.
responsible.wildlife: Wildlife is observed from a respectful distance. We do not promote elephant riding or contact experiences.
responsible.closing: Experience Kerala thoughtfully, with the people and places at the centre.

process.title: Your journey starts before you fly.

steps.title: Before you leave
steps.body: Journey planning, flight coordination, visa support, travel information, packing guidance, itinerary preparation and pre-trip communication.

steps.title: When you arrive
steps.body: Airport pickup, local introduction, hotel check-in support, guide assistance and transport coordination.

steps.title: Along the way
steps.body: Local guidance, daily assistance, experience coordination, route support, recommendations and emergency assistance.

steps.title: When it is time to go home
steps.body: Airport transfer and departure assistance to complete the journey.

menu.title: Pick what you love.
menu.body: Choose as many or as few as you like. Your selections carry into the enquiry form.

faq.title: A few things you may be wondering.

items.a: No. The suggested journeys are starting points. We build the route around your interests, travel dates and pace.
From one week to a longer journey. Choose 7, 10, 14 or 21 days, or tell us the duration you have in mind.
Couples, friends, families and private groups. The starting offer is for a minimum of two travellers; other group arrangements can be discussed.

items.q: What does the starting price include?
items.a: Inclusions depend on the itinerary, travel dates, flights, stays and experiences. Your proposal specifies the full price and all inclusions before booking.

items.q: Will a local guide accompany us?
items.a: Local guidance is central to the journey. Your proposal confirms the arrangements, including accompaniment for a motorcycle journey.

items.q: Can we include a motorcycle adventure?
items.a: Yes, it can be discussed for experienced riders. The route, licence, insurance, rental and equipment requirements are confirmed during planning.

items.q: Are wildlife sightings and cultural events guaranteed?
items.a: No. Wildlife is unpredictable, and some cultural experiences depend on season, location and local schedules. We plan suitable options for your dates.

items.q: Does sending an enquiry book a trip?
items.a: No. It starts a conversation about your travel ideas. Final arrangements and pricing are confirmed before you book.
